messages.subject: Comparable results in MARK
parts:
I have 13 years of robust design spatially explicit CMR data and I am estimating lambda in OpenCR.  I want to check my estimates with non-spatial estimates in MARK.  I first ran a non-spatial Pradel model in OpenCR (fit2.2.UARB<-openCR.fit(UARBCHF, model=list(phi~1, p~1, lambda~1), method="Nelder-Mead", type='JSSAlCL') #Pradel-lambda model) but the results are different from my results in MARK using this model ({Phi(sex), lambda (sex), p( sex), f0(sex)}) as a robust design Pradel lambda full likelihood p an c model in MARK (the OpenCR model is for females only so I have to run a sex model in MARK because that data set is for both sexes).  

My results are significantly different even when I modeled f0 in MARK as fully time independent.  Any idea why my results are different?  I tried to run a simple CJS model in MARK but that is difficult because all the robust design applications require the estimation of the gamma' and gamma" parameters, and while I formatted it as a random movement model, the results also are different.  I checked the capture summaries for both platforms and they are identical.  Thanks!
